headline: UAH last unbeaten side after Trevecca fall
dek: Trevecca's defeat at home to Lee on Wednesday leaves UAH the only programme yet to lose a match. They have won six and drawn one, conceding three goals in seven, and go to AUM on Saturday, who are unbeaten in the conference too.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Goals have not meant points: West Alabama have scored 26 and conceded sixteen, and have won three of nine matches.

wire.line: Every programme but UAH has now lost at least once.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches have passed their date with no result, and all three are Christian Brothers', the earliest at home to McKendree.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Spring Hill have scored one goal in five matches and have lost four of them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has conceded nine goals for Trevecca and kept three clean sheets.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Alabama's 26 goals have come from eight different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Patrick Schott has made 51 saves for Union and has conceded eleven goals.

last_match.line: Trevecca's first defeat of the season leaves UAH the only programme yet to lose; Lee have alternated wins and defeats since conference play opened.

next_match.line: The table's top two meet: AUM have won every conference match they have played, and UAH have yet to lose one anywhere.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
